title: The Bleeding Painting
description: A dimly lit, dilapidated room with peeling green walls and blood splatters contains a large, ornate painting of a grotesque undead figure holding a bloody knife and a human heart with a lit candle. In the foreground, a wooden desk holds a lit lamp, vintage radio, open book, coffee cup, gloves, and a police hat. A woman in a dark uniform stands watching as a shadowy figure emerges from a red-lit doorway in the background.
